sec: Hepatic vasculature: the portal vein · p1001

items.q: The portal vein is formed behind the neck of the pancreas by the junction of the splenic vein and the:
items.exp: Formation: splenic vein and superior mesenteric veins join behind the neck of pancreas. (Book p1001)

items.q: The portal vein develops from the:
opts: Inferior segment of the left and right vitelline veins
Superior segment of the left and right vitelline veins
items.exp: Development: ‘Inferior segment of left and right vitelline veins joins to form portal vein’. (Book p1001)

items.q: The length of the portal vein given on p1001 is:
The haemodynamic character of the portal vein stated on p1001 is:
items.exp: ‘Portal vein has high compliance low resistance’. (Book p1001)

items.q: Match the portal-branching diagram labels of p1001 — 1) Umbilical vein  2) Cystic vein  3) 1st order portal vein  4) 3rd order portal vein (Bifurcation) … A) Bifurcates in the lobe  B) Main trunk  C) Drains into the right portal vein  D) Drains into the left portal vein
items.exp: ‘Umbilical vein drains into left portal vein’, ‘Cystic vein drains into right portal vein’, 1st order portal vein is the main trunk, and the 3rd order portal vein carries the (Bifurcation) label. (Book p1001)

items.q: Hepatic ischaemia remains rare in portal hypertension because of the hepatic buffer response — its basis on p1001 is:
opts: Dual blood supply of the liver (portal vein + hepatic artery)
Dilatation of the vasa recta around the central vein
Collateral flow through the paraumbilical veins
Arterialisation of portal inflow at the sinusoidal level
items.exp: Note: hepatic buffer response — hepatic ischaemia is rare d/t dual blood supply, portal vein / hepatic artery. (Book p1001)

items.q: At the hilum, the portal vein lies with respect to the hepatic artery and bile duct — the relation stated on p1001 is:
opts: Posterior to the hepatic artery and bile duct
Anterior to the hepatic artery and bile duct
Medial to the bile duct and anterior to the hepatic artery
Lateral to both the hepatic artery and bile duct
items.exp: Under formation: ‘Hilum posterior to hepatic and bile duct’ — the portal vein lies posterior to the hepatic artery and bile duct. (Book p1001)
